meta.title: Opened notification is marked read
gaps: Open the buyer portal notification bell and select the unread assignment notification for PR-1.
Verify the notification is marked read.
Verify the unread notification count decreases by one.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Open the buyer portal notification bell and select the unread assignment notification for PR-1.; Verify the notification is marked read.; Verify the unread notification count decreases by one.

args.need: sign in as User A, open the notification bell, open the unread assignment notification for PR-1, reopen the bell, and verify it is marked read with the unread count reduced by one

steps.note: No catalog step can navigate buyer notifications or observe notification read state and unread-count changes.
Provides a final screen assertion if the tester leaves the notifications panel open, but does not cover the requested read-state or count assertion.
